_: Tier-3 arcade floor (DECISIONS.md CR-13). Config here, never in the logic. Read at build time and emitted as data attributes, so the page performs no runtime fetch.
_liveSlots: Cabinets running at once. Each is a real game in an iframe with its own animation loop, so this is a CPU budget, not a layout preference. Raising it past 4 makes a mid-range laptop audible.
_powerOnMs: How long a cabinet takes to arrive and light up before the next one starts.
_runMs: How long a cabinet runs its attract screen before the row files down. This is the watching time - the number that matters most here, the way holdMs matters on tier 2.
_powerDownMs: The hand-off: capture a frame, dim, and move to the floor below.
_captureFrames: Before a cabinet powers down, read a real frame off its canvas and use it as the plate on the floor. Same-origin, so this is allowed. There are no screenshots of these games anywhere; this makes real ones from the game actually running. If a game has no canvas or the read fails, the plate falls back to type - never a blank box, never a stock image.
_loop: Restart from the first cabinet after the last. Off: the floor stands as the result.
